summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic reported that Tom Allen was arrested for firing his revolver in front of his saloon near Seventh and Market streets; returning from a party, he found the place deserted and fired to attract a crowd.

metadata.notes: masthead: The Republic, St. Louis, Wednesday Morning, April 28, 1897, page 12

facts.fact: Allen was arrested for discharging his revolver in front of his saloon near Seventh and Market streets; after drinking at a party he found his saloon deserted and fired the gun to attract a crowd. He was to be tried by Judge Peabody the following Friday
places: Seventh and Market streets, St. Louis
